rationale_bullets: Houser arrives with genuine full-volume tape: 84.0 PFF on 473 dropbacks at ECU in 2025 (AAC QB discount is +0 - the table converts it at par), 12 starts, 3,300 yds, 65.9%, 19-6, 4th in AAC rating; two-year ECU line 5,306/37-17.

The adjusted tape alone argues p75+ (QB unit p75 reference = South Carolina 81.1); the grade is pulled well below the mechanical read for named risks: his earlier P4 stint was ordinary (Michigan State: 7 starts, 1,132 yds, 58.5%), P6 flags that he 'lacks the elusiveness of Altmyer... an issue given the complete rebuild of the offensive line,' and the OL projects bottom-quartile (38).

Mitigants: OC Lunney continuity (system stays; only the QB changes), former 4* pedigree, PS top-15 QB listing (unit-level, attributed), Athlon spring reporting ('strong impression... talent and leadership').
Depth is zero-proof: backup is FR Carson Boyd after Hampton portaled to Southern Miss - one injury from a cliff.

Scale check vs completed set: clearly above ISU's Raynor (48, weaker tape) and TCU's Craig (46, FCS jump); clearly below Utah's returning dual-threat room (70, in-house tape). 62 = solidly above-average B10 QB play with real translation variance.
